title: soc2-prep-scratchpad-lucas-wong
content:
SOC2 Type II prep - scratchpad (notes to self)

Scope/goal:
- Target: SOC2 Type II for Redwood Hosted + Dedicated in scope, include Private (VPC) as optional scoped-by-customer.
- Timeframe: aim for audit window starting 2026-06-01 (discuss with auditor) -> need baseline controls in place by 2026-04.

High-level gaps (initial):
- Formal change mgmt: we have informal PR approvals + release notes, but missing documented change board and emergency change log for the audit period. (owner: Ryan Chen)
- Least privilege / role reviews: AD/Okta role attestation cadence unclear for infra/ops. Need quarterly attestation process. (owner: Maya Singh)
- Vendor mgmt: third-party vendor inventory is partial (S3 backups, monitoring vendor). Need contracts + SOC2/ISO docs. (owner: Lena)
- Logging & retention: logs collected centrally but retention policy ambiguous; correlate with evidence collection.
- Incident response exercises: tabletop scheduled ad-hoc, need documented runbook and 1 tabletop recorded before audit.
- Encryption KMS: customer keys (Bring Your Own Key) path for Private deployments needs documented flow and access controls.

Control mapping notes (quick):
- CC6: change mgmt -> map to release-engineering runbook + PR approval + emergency release log (create template).
- CC7: logical access -> Okta groups, IAM roles, periodic access reviews + access removal SOP (offboarding).
- CC8: system operations -> patch mgmt cadence: weekly security patch window + exceptions log.
- CC9: backup & restore -> S3 backups + restore playbook + test restore evidence (run a restore once).

Evidence checklist (what to collect):
- Policies: Change mgmt policy (draft okay but must be dated), Access control policy, InfoSec policy.
- Procedures: Onboarding/offboarding, patch mgmt, backup/restore runbook, incident response runbook.
- Logs: Admin activity logs (Okta), infra change logs (k8s/operator events), deployment audit trail (CI/CD run ids).
- Tickets: Jira ones for incidents + change approvals.
- Screenshots: Okta admin page showing groups and user lists + permission matrix export.
- Meeting notes: tabletop exercise notes + action items.

Open questions / to-do (quick, rough):
- Q1: Do we include PRDs or only operational runbooks? Auditor asked for both policy & operational evidence. (ask audit lead)
- Q2: Private deployments with BYOK — need documented separation of duties; who keys are accessible to? (ops vs. customer).
- Q3: What retention period auditor expects for logs? 90 days vs 1 year? check auditor checklist.

Immediate next actions (short list):
- Draft Change Management template (Lucas) - include emergency change log format. DUE: 2026-01-15 (past? update schedule).
- Schedule access attestation meeting w/ Okta owners (Maya) - add checklist for reviewers.
- Vendor inventory: ask procurement for master list + current security attestations (Lena).
- Run a backup restore test on staging and capture screenshots + restore ticket (owner: infra team).
- Create evidence folder in shared Confluence + link to this doc.

Notes to self (messy):
- Slack threads: #sec-soc2 and #ops-release have useful links; search for "change log".
- There was a PR (https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/342) that added deployment tags; need to map to change evidence.
- Need to confirm whether Dedicated clusters are on same audit scope (contract says yes) -> check legal.

Draft risk questions for auditor / internal review:
- Risk: Unauthorized access to customer data via misconfigured IAM. Mitigation: role separation, MFA, quarterly access review, alert on admin outside business hours.
- Risk: Incomplete backups -> Mitigation: scheduled backups + test restores quarterly.
- Risk: Untracked emergency changes -> Mitigation: emergency change log + retrospective review for post-incident change.

Quick sketch of control owner assignments (preliminary):
- Change mgmt: Ryan Chen (release-engineering)
- Access control & SSO: Maya Singh (platform-auth)
- Backup & restore: Infrastructure team lead (TBD)
- Incident response: SRE/Oncall rotation + Security (Lena Morales)
- Vendor mgmt: Procurement -> CC: Legal/Finance review

WIP prompts for write-ups (use when drafting final docs):
- "How we approve, document, and roll back changes" - include CI/CD link, PR template, and emergency process.
- "Access attestation process" - include reviewer list, cadence, and evidence export steps.
- "Backup restore evidence" - steps to reproduce restore + screenshots + ticket link.

Random TODOs:
- Convert this scratchpad into Confluence page (sparse bullets -> fleshed out)
- Capture one incident timeline as example evidence for IR control

Important links to fetch:
- Confluence: /display/SEC/SOC2+Control+Mapping+v2
- Github PRs: infra#342, security#98
- Jira: JIRA-SEC-134 (control mapping backlog), JIRA-OPS-211 (restore test)

---
Notes end. Keep this as living scratchpad. Throwaway sections okay. Will iterate with Maya/Ryan/Lena.
